description:
Create a new Settings Container in the Vicidial admin interface with the following details:

- Container ID: CID_EAST_COAST
- Container Notes: East Coast regional CID mappings for outbound campaigns
- Container Type: CID_GROUP
- Container Entry (one mapping per line, format is areacode,callerid):
  202,2025550134
  212,2125550178
  617,6175550192
  305,3055550156
  404,4045550123
  215,2155550145

Navigate to the Settings Containers section under Admin in the Vicidial admin panel, create a new container with these exact values, and save it.

The Vicidial admin panel is open in Firefox at http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php (login: 6666 / andromeda).
